SELECT payment_method,
    (date_trunc('day'::text, created_at))::date AS transaction_date,
    count(*) AS daily_transactions,
    sum(amount) AS daily_revenue,
    count(DISTINCT member_id) AS unique_members,
    count(DISTINCT business_id) AS unique_businesses,
    avg(amount) AS avg_transaction_amount
   FROM deal_receipts
  GROUP BY payment_method, (date_trunc('day'::text, created_at))
  ORDER BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, created_at))::date) DESC, payment_method;

SELECT s.id AS subscription_id,
    s.user_id,
    s.plan_type,
    s.renewal_charge_cents,
    s.current_period_end,
    s.auto_renew,
    p.email,
    p.paystack_customer_code,
    mcd.authorization_code,
    mcd.card_type,
    mcd.last4,
    p.email AS card_email
   FROM ((subscriptions s
     JOIN profiles p ON ((p.id = s.user_id)))
     LEFT JOIN members_card_details mcd ON (((mcd.user_id = s.user_id) AND (mcd.is_primary = true) AND (mcd.is_active = true))))
  WHERE ((s.status = 'active'::text) AND (s.auto_renew = true) AND (s.current_period_end <= (now() + '01:00:00'::interval)) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM subscription_renewals sr
          WHERE ((sr.user_id = s.user_id) AND (sr.status = 'success'::text) AND (sr.renewal_date >= (s.current_period_end - '01:00:00'::interval)) AND (sr.renewal_date <= (s.current_period_end + '25:00:00'::interval)))))));

SELECT d.id AS deal_id,
    d.name AS deal_name,
    d.trusted_partner_id AS owner_user_id,
    d.business_id,
    d.deal_category,
    d.city,
    get_deal_end_date(d.schedule_data) AS end_date,
    b.name AS business_name,
    b.business_email,
    p.email AS owner_email,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM concat(p.name, ' ', p.surname)), ''::text), 'Partner'::text) AS owner_name
   FROM ((trusted_partner_discounts d
     LEFT JOIN businesses b ON ((b.id = d.business_id)))
     LEFT JOIN profiles p ON ((p.id = d.trusted_partner_id)))
  WHERE ((d.is_active = true) AND (get_deal_end_date(d.schedule_data) IS NOT NULL) AND (get_deal_end_date(d.schedule_data) < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text))::date));

SELECT d.id AS deal_id,
    d.name AS deal_name,
    d.trusted_partner_id AS owner_user_id,
    d.business_id,
    d.deal_category,
    d.city,
    get_deal_end_date(d.schedule_data) AS end_date,
    b.name AS business_name,
    b.business_email,
    p.email AS owner_email,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM concat(p.name, ' ', p.surname)), ''::text), 'Partner'::text) AS owner_name
   FROM ((trusted_partner_discounts d
     LEFT JOIN businesses b ON ((b.id = d.business_id)))
     LEFT JOIN profiles p ON ((p.id = d.trusted_partner_id)))
  WHERE ((d.is_active = true) AND (get_deal_end_date(d.schedule_data) = ((((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text))::date + '1 day'::interval))::date));
